title: Originate tenant configuration
description: Single source of truth for a company's Originate instance. See docs/CONFIG-SCHEMA.md for the annotated walkthrough and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4 for why this replaces a CLAUDE.md-prose + scoringRubric.ts + SKILL.md-prose triplication.

approverTitle.description: Who approves Stage A output before spend continues, e.g. 'deal lead', 'hiring lead', 'underwriting leadership'.

thesisMultiple.description: Optional. Only present for verticals with a re-rate/multiple-expansion thesis (e.g. VC/PE '8-10x revenue'). Omit entirely for verticals with no comparable concept -- templates must not render a thesis-multiple paragraph when this is absent.

purposeNote.description: Optional free text captured during onboarding: what this tenant is sourcing and what a good one looks like, in their own words. Not rendered into any skill template -- it's provenance for why the criteria below look the way they do, read by whichever assistant reopens this config for editing later.

id.description: Short identifier, e.g. a person's first name or a team name.

styleNotes.description: Voice/tone description used to render outreach drafts in this profile's voice.

vertical.description: Which starter config + vertical overlay seeded this tenant. No runtime effect after generation -- see docs/CONFIG-SCHEMA.md.

entity.description: Singular noun for what this pipeline sources, e.g. 'company', 'candidate', 'property', 'submission'.

verdicts.description: Ordered set of allowed final verdict values for the diligence memo (or scoring outcome, if diligence is disabled). No fixed length or wording -- e.g. VC uses PROCEED/PROCEED_WITH_GAPS/PASS/NEEDS_MORE_INFO, insurance MGA uses BIND/DECLINE/REFER.

unitNoun.description: What Stage A's unit of work is called, e.g. 'category', 'mandate', 'market thesis'. Optional -- templates fall back to 'category' via {{pipeline.stageA.unitNoun|| "category"}} when unset.

inputNoun.description: What the human names to kick off Stage A, e.g. 'category name', 'role/mandate name'. Optional, same fallback pattern as unitNoun.

stageA.description: Optional vocabulary for Stage A (category research). Every reference to it in templates/core/*.tmpl uses the {{path|| "default"}} fallback syntax, so omitting this object entirely is valid and renders sensible VC-flavored defaults.

title.description: Heading rendered in the category-research skill, e.g. 'Competitive dynamics'.

prompt.description: What the skill must answer for this question.

jsonKey.description: snake_case key this answer is written under in the Stage A JSON output.

stageAQuestions.description: The required questions Stage A (category-research) must answer before a human can approve it. VC's four (competitive dynamics, customer segmentation, workflow product quality, exit landscape) are the reference set; every vertical defines its own -- there is no shared default.

immediatePass.description: Hard stop-and-pass rules checked first, before any other work.

tiers.description: Ordered list; an entity matches the first tier (in list order) whose rules all pass.

judgmentSignals.description: Qualitative signals with no threshold value, rendered into the scoring skill's prompt for holistic judgment.

escalateTo.description: Who/what this flag escalates to -- never a silent auto-pass.

onMissingData.description: Never guess, never screen out for a missing field -- set null and flag it.

connectors.description: Each array names connector ids from the registry (docs/CONNECTOR-CATALOG.md). Note there is deliberately no 'commsSend' role anywhere in this schema -- a comms connector can only ever be asked to draft.

folder.description: The single folder this specialist is locked to reading. Never widened at runtime.

question.description: What this specialist is looking for, beyond its folder's default scope.

sharedFolderOk.description: True only for the documented exception where two specialists share a folder but ask different questions.

sharedFolderReason.description: Required whenever sharedFolderOk is true: which folder is shared and why this specialist's question differs from the other specialist(s) reading it.

diligence.description: enabled: false with specialists: [] is a fully valid, first-class state -- see the sales-agency vertical in docs/VERTICAL-PLAYBOOKS.md.

budget.description: Advisory only -- nothing in this schema enforces spend.

primary.description: Who executes the pipeline day to day. Exactly one -- a run needs a deterministic runtime, not an ambiguous choice made at run time.

skillEditing.description: Who helps author/edit config and skills. May be 'both'.

field.description: Free-text field name, resolved against whatever data this tenant's discovery/enrichment connectors actually populate.
